owner.name: Chris
owner.role: Runs Northwind Seed, a small seed fund; sits on the Kestrel Robotics board; builds Hot Mic on GBrain on the side.

capture: Hot Mic iPhone recorder in a pocket, voice-gated, transcribed on the Mac with local Whisper; no audio kept, only text.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Okay. Thursday. Walking. Uh, things for today.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Kestrel board meeting is Monday and I haven't even opened the deck. I need to actually read it before the weekend, not Sunday night again.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: The dentist moved me to Tuesday at ten, which is, that's right on top of IC. So that has to move.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Someday I should write a book about this. Decision fatigue for investors. Like, a chief of staff for one person. Someday.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Text Sam about the two o'clock, make sure we're still on.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: This coffee is not good. Why do I keep coming here.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Oh, and the Kestrel bridge. I still have to send our wire. Today.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Also I should learn to sail. Every September I say that.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Morning. Did you get my Fernhill memo?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: I did, I've read, like, half. It's good. The market section's a little long.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Okay, few quick things. Arlo Vance from Quarry Labs wants a first meeting, and he asked for Friday at two.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Friday. Hm.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: I know. He flies home Saturday, that's why he asked.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Second, Nina at Fernhill asked if you'd intro her to Dev at Kestrel. They're both doing warehouse robots and she wants to compare notes on pilots.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Sure, Dev's great. He's, uh, he's got a lot going on this week though.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: And the Cascadia Seed Summit in Boise asked if you'd do a fireside chat. October fifteenth. It's about eighty people.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: I'd do it, honestly. If they want someone from Northwind.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Last thing. IC is Tuesday, so I really need your comments on the memo before I send the final.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll get you comments on the memo by five today.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Perfect. Oh, and did you see the thing about the, never mind, it's not important.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Can someone close the door? The espresso machine is screaming again.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, pipeline first. Quarry, Fernhill, Halcyon.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Before we start I have to say something about the CRM. I spent forty minutes yesterday trying to log one intro. Forty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Here we go.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: I'm serious. We should rip it out and build our own. It's a weekend project. A spreadsheet and a couple of agents.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: It's never a weekend project.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: It would be if we just did it! Every fund I know hates their CRM. We could sell it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: We are not selling a CRM, Jordan.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Halcyon. I'll do the reference call on their CEO myself, I worked with her old CFO. Nobody else needs to be on it.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Fernhill goes to IC Tuesday, once Chris's comments are in.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: And honestly the pipeline view is why we dropped the follow-up with, who was it, the battery people.

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: Oh, um, one more thing, sorry. Tidewater got a term sheet last night. It's exploding, seventy-two hours. Our pro-rata would be about four hundred.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Can I just finish? The pipeline view. If we built our own it would just show us what's gone stale.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Jordan, write it up and we'll look at it in Q1. Maybe.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: I'm writing it up. I'm writing it up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, Quarry. Maya, where are we?

utterances.speaker: Maya Chen
utterances.text: First meeting's being set up with Chris.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Did anyone else get the building email? They're towing in the back lot on Fridays now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, let's stop there, I have a hard stop.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: This place still has the best ramen on the block. How's Theo? Still doing soccer?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Soccer, and now drums. Pray for us.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: Ha. Okay. The bridge docs are signed on our side, by the way.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Great. Our wire goes out this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: So, the real thing. I'm thinking about letting Greg go. Before the board meeting. I don't want to walk in Monday with this hanging over the room.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Okay. That's, uh, that's fast.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: Pipeline's been flat two quarters. He's great with the big logos but nothing closes. And half his team is paid on bookings, not collections, so it's a mess.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Has he seen his numbers against a plan he actually agreed to?

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: Sort of. Not formally.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Send me the comp plan. I'll look at the comp plan.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: Thank you. Also, could you intro me to someone at Harborline Logistics? I heard they're piloting robots in two warehouses.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: I know Renee Park, their COO. Yeah, she'd take the call.

utterances.speaker: Dev Patel
utterances.text: Amazing. Okay, tell me about the fund. Is Jordan still trying to build his own CRM?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Every single week.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Hey. Can you hear me? My mic's doing the thing.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, the receipt bug. If you reload the page in the middle of a session, the same receipt fires twice.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Repro: say the Friday line, get the red receipt, reload the page, say it again. You get a second red receipt for the same claim, and it acts like it's new.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: So the once-per-session rule doesn't survive a reload.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. I think the client keeps the fired list in memory, and the server replays the last event when the socket reconnects.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Other question. Should we just use OpenAI embeddings to go faster? bge-m3 on the laptop is slow on the big pack.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Hmm. Let's, uh, let me think about that.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Also the Apple developer account renews next week. Ninety-nine dollars. Can I just put it on the card?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Probably. Yeah, probably.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: And we should add Slack someday. Like, the receipts could post to a channel.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Someday.

utterances.speaker: Sam Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, I'm going to go fight the iOS build. It's decided the simulator doesn't exist.

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: Chris, hi. Sorry, I'm in the car, it might cut out.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: No problem. How was the college tour?

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: Exhausting. Six campuses, one kid who hated all of them.

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: Two things. Our committee meets October twelfth, so we need the Q3 letter by October tenth. Last quarter's came late and I got asked about it.

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: And please put the marks and the DPI up front. They skip straight to that.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Understood. The tenth.

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: Second. I heard Tidewater's raising. If you're not taking your full allocation, we'd love to co-invest.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Oh. Let me, I'll check where that is and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Helen Marsh
utterances.text: Of course. And we're likely in for Fund Three, just so you know. Nothing formal.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Linh asked if we're coming to dinner at the Nguyens' on the third. I said probably. Can you RSVP? She wants to know by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, we're going.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: And Theo's permission slip for the aquarium trip is due Friday. It's in the school app. You have to sign it, I did the last one.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Your phone's buzzing again.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: It's Dev. He wants to talk tonight.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Tonight tonight?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: No. I'll move him to the morning.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: We should repaint the kitchen. I'm serious this time. That green.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: We should. At some point.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Okay. End of day. The Kestrel bridge wire went out at three, I got the confirmation. So that's done.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: I keep saying yes to too many coffees. Four this week. Four. I don't know.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Maya's memo comments. I said five. Didn't happen. First thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Helen asked about a Tidewater co-invest and honestly I don't know what's going on with Tidewater right now. I should find out.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Okay. Bed.
